definitions: Follow the trail or scent of (someone or something).
Monitor the progress or movement of (someone or something).
Follow or move along (a particular course).
Make a mark or a series of marks on (a surface) with feet or wheels.
Relate or correspond to something else over time.
examples: The police tracked the suspect to a remote cabin.
We use GPS to track our vehicles.
Muddy boots tracked dirt across the clean floor.
His performance tracked the market trends.
